description: In change detection with cues at different times, observers showed iconic memory of up to 32 items that depended on a retinal afterimage, a fragile visual short-term memory lasting about four seconds with at least twice the capacity of working memory, and durable working memory of about four items. Light flashes erased iconic memory but not fragile memory, while a pattern mask of new items erased fragile memory.
limitations: From Lamme's group, building on Landman et al. 2003 from the same group. The authors state that a link to recurrent processing still needs neurophysiological confirmation.

sources.quote: a four seconds lasting fragile VSTM store with a capacity that is at least a factor of two higher than 3) the robust and capacity-limited form of VSTM
Fragile VSTM representations were not affected by light masks, but were completely overwritten by irrelevant pattern masks that spatially overlapped the memory array.
